name: Beaver Habit Tracker
description: Minimal, fast habit tracker: quick daily check-ins, streaks and a clean calendar view. No accounts, no analytics.
compose:
services:
  beaver:
    image: daya0576/beaver:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:1230"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/app/.data
    restart: unless-stopped
